claim_boundary: This establishes a source-level checkpoint mechanism and a concrete opened acquisition resource boundary. It does not establish that two candidates exist in the archive, pass replay/determinism/reset checks, diverge within the frozen boundary, or are globally equivalent. It makes no ontology-revision, identification, planning-value, decision-superiority, sealed, or Track B claim.

animation_and_multiframe_serialization.claim_boundary: Preserve all released frames as evidence; candidate replay/dedup is explicitly settled-state only and makes no animation fidelity claim.
animation_and_multiframe_serialization.source_finding: Session tooling records intermediate and final frames, but the executable verifier compares the final settled frame and status.

game_source_and_web_leakage.source_finding: The selected architecture places Codex in a separate container from the game implementation and starts fresh workspaces. The public repository claims no game-specific code or prompts.
game_source_and_web_leakage.unresolved_run_check: Inspect actual archive mounts, client/server logs, transcripts, downloaded files, scorecards, Git history, and any web/network artifacts. Public-game knowledge in pretrained model weights cannot be excluded by source inspection.

hidden_conversation_or_service_state.admission_rule: Only extracted executable code/static dependencies may run later; fresh offline processes must succeed without the hosted thread or credentials.
hidden_conversation_or_service_state.source_finding: Generation uses a hosted Codex session and authentication state.

parameterized_click_actions.authority_finding: Official ACTION6 has a finite x,y domain 0..63 by 0..63, while P0 reveals only whether ACTION6 is available.
parameterized_click_actions.frozen_handling: Use all 4096 one-step coordinates if ACTION6 is present; do not use candidate-proposed click targets.

state_initialization.admission_rule: P0 and files inside the immutable candidate bundle are the only allowed inputs. Any later-observation, missing-file, or hosted-state dependency blocks admission.
state_initialization.source_finding: The model exposes initial-state reconstruction and rendering, with possible checkpoint-contained helper artifacts.

resource_authorization_boundary.estimated_temporary_disk: 2-5 GiB; exact expansion is unavailable until the gzip tar is downloaded/listed.
resource_authorization_boundary.required_operation: Download article2_main_runs_additional.tar.gz from Zenodo record 21412274, verify MD5 4dd279f099609392c30cffa468801316, compute local SHA-256, read-only extract, and inventory only the two selected ls20 run trees and their checkpoint/dependency closure.
why_released_source_and_non_mutating_che: GitHub contains empty model stubs and aggregate result tables, not generated candidate bytes.
The Zenodo metadata does not expose its internal per-run file list.
Retention/completeness of .git objects, iteration tags, or immutable snapshots is unknown.
P0 bytes, full game version, available actions, ordered frames, and candidate initialization inputs cannot be hashed.
Offline reset, exact P0 replay, cross-process determinism, service independence, and finite behavioral divergence cannot be tested.

verdict_basis: The selected public learner source naturally creates per-iteration executable snapshots and a public run archive is pinned by size, MD5, DOI, and record license. The actual candidates, P0, dependency closure, and traces are only inside a 797,835,543-byte compressed archive. The prompt requires stopping before that scarce-resource download/extraction.
